payload.claim: The comment enumerating what the golden fixture does and does not cover never mentions the aborted-baseline / PREFLIGHT_FAILED path (`baseline errored in ...`), and indeed neither driven scenario (`suites=([], [])` and `suites=([], _results(failing), _results(failing))`) ever makes a declared gate error, so that branch of `describe()`'s `Baseline` handling (see the sibling finding on `saffron/events.py:453`) is exercised by no test at all. AC5 explicitly requires recording in the comment which kinds/branches the fixture does not prove, and this omission leaves `SA-0030`/`SA-0031` trusting coverage that doesn't exist for the one line most tied to `Baseline.aborted`'s own stated purpose.
